column1: # mapping_set_title: 'EU 2025 GPAI Model Documentation Form <-> SPDX 3.1-dev'

# mapping_set_description: 'Maps the 41 information items of the Model Documentation Form (Transparency Chapter, Measure 1.1, EU Code of Practice for General-Purpose AI Models, implementing Art. 53(1)(a)-(b) and Annexes XI/XII of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689) to properties, classes and RelationshipType individuals of the SPDX 3.1-dev model (AI, Dataset, Software, Build, Hardware and Core profiles). Rows whose comment starts with GAP identify information the SPDX AI profile cannot carry natively (parameter count, training compute in FLOP, input/output modalities and sizes, provenance categories, Union-market release date, distribution access level, measurement methodologies); these are candidate inputs to the SPDX AI profile. The see_also column cites the bridge concept from bom.ttl. The three recipient marks AIO / NCA / DP (gpaimdf2025:audience-aio / -nca / -dp in the separate scheme gpaimdf2025:scheme-audience, attached to each item with dcterms:audience) are not information items and have no SPDX counterpart; they are intentionally not mapped. Revised 2026-10-28: the training and inference compute rows no longer suggest hyperparameter or metric as carriers (neither fits a measured amount); as in bom-to-spdx31, the training and inference compute, input and output modalities, total model size, data points and data scope (domain aspect) rows gain a broadMatch row to Core/additionalInformation (keys trainingCompute, inferenceCompute, inputModality, outputModality, contextLength, maxOutputLength, parameterCount, itemCount, itemType, subjectDomain).'

column8: comment

column2: Date this document was last updated
column8: When the Model Documentation is carried as (or alongside) an SPDX AI BOM, CreationInfo.created of the current Sbom revision records the last update; each update is a new revision linked with amendedBy.
Core/Bom.version (3.1-dev) on the Sbom carries the documentation version number.

column2: Legal name for the model provider
column8: AIPackage (Artifact).originatedBy -> Organization whose name is the provider's legal name; suppliedBy covers a distributor. Organization.headquartersLocation (3.1-dev) adds the establishment address; ExternalIdentifier types lei / vatNumber / eori / duns can carry legal identifiers.

AIPackage.name is the model name; the collection identifier and the list of covered public versions have no native fields: model each version as its own AIPackage (name + version) and group them in a Bundle or link with hasVariant, or carry collection membership via contains from a collection Package. GAP (cardinality) for alternate names.

The unique identifier aspect: Package.packageUrl (pkg:huggingface/... or pkg:generic/...) and ExternalIdentifier give the machine-readable unique identifier; the 'Llama 3.1-405B'-style identifier also fits Core/version.

AIPackage.verifiedUsing -> Hash (algorithm + hashValue) over the distributed weights/binaries provides the secure-hash evidence; for a service, SoftwareService (Service profile, 3.1-dev) or ExternalRef gives the URL endpoint. closeMatch: cryptographic signatures of the model are external.
SoftwareArtifact.contentIdentifier (gitoid / swhid) gives an intrinsic, content-derived identifier that also establishes authenticity of the model files. closeMatch.
Artifact.releaseTime = date of first release through any distribution channel.

GAP (missing field): no jurisdiction-specific placing-on-the-market date. Carry it as a second dated fact: e.g. a SupplyChain/BoundaryCrossingAction (3.1-dev) with startTime and actionLocation (EU), or an Element.comment. releaseTime remains the global first-release date. closeMatch.

Base-model lineage: Relationship with relationshipType descendantOf (or ancestorOf) from the modified / fine-tuned AIPackage to the AIPackage(s) of the general-purpose AI model(s) it derives from, each with name and version; finetunedOn / pretrainedOn add the datasets of each stage; hasVariant links sibling variants. Write 'N/A' as absence of such relationships (completeness complete).
GAP (missing field): no architecture field distinct from the free-text typeOfModel; state the architecture there. broadMatch (container fallback).
Element.description on the AIPackage: free-text design description. closeMatch.
AIPackage.typeOfModel (0..*, string) is the only field that can hold the architecture part of the design specification; rationale and assumptions fall back to Element.description. closeMatch.

GAP (missing field): no structured input modality / maximum input size field in the AI profile. State modalities and maximum sizes in informationAboutApplication or typeOfModel; AI/InteractionTemplate (3.1-dev) can describe the input structure. broadMatch (container fallback). (Dataset/datasetType has the modality vocabulary, but applies to datasets, not model I/O.)

GAP (missing field): no structured input modality or maximum input size field. Core/additionalInformation (0..*, DictionaryEntry key/value; on SoftwareArtifact and so on AIPackage and DatasetPackage since the 2026-10 3.1-dev model) is the structured carrier for an intrinsic characteristic that has no dedicated property. Record the modalities under the key 'inputModality' (comma-separated list such as 'text,image') and the maximum input size under 'contextLength' (tokens). Preferred over the free-text informationAboutApplication row. additionalInformationSpecification can name the Specification that defines the key. broadMatch (container fallback; key convention only, not standardised). No SPDX 3.0.1 counterpart.
GAP (missing field): no structured output modality / maximum output size field. Same free-text fallback as input modalities. broadMatch (container fallback).

GAP (missing field): no structured output modality or maximum output size field. Core/additionalInformation (0..*, DictionaryEntry key/value; on SoftwareArtifact and so on AIPackage and DatasetPackage since the 2026-10 3.1-dev model) is the structured carrier for an intrinsic characteristic that has no dedicated property. Record the modalities under the key 'outputModality' (comma-separated list such as 'text') and the maximum output size under 'maxOutputLength' (tokens). Preferred over the free-text informationAboutApplication row. additionalInformationSpecification can name the Specification that defines the key. broadMatch (container fallback; key convention only, not standardised). No SPDX 3.0.1 counterpart.

GAP (missing field): no parameter-count field. Carry the count (or range) as an AIPackage.hyperparameter DictionaryEntry (e.g. key 'parameterCount', value '7.3e10'); SoftwareArtifact.byteSize gives only the storage size of the weight files. broadMatch (container fallback).

GAP (missing field): no parameter-count field. Core/additionalInformation (0..*, DictionaryEntry key/value; on SoftwareArtifact and so on AIPackage and DatasetPackage since the 2026-10 3.1-dev model) is the structured carrier for an intrinsic characteristic that has no dedicated property. Record the count under the key 'parameterCount' (two significant figures such as '7.3e10' for the AI Office, or a range such as '1e10-1e11' for national competent authorities and downstream providers). Preferred over the hyperparameter row: hyperparameter by definition excludes the learned parameters. additionalInformationSpecification can name the Specification that defines the key. broadMatch (container fallback; key convention only, not standardised). No SPDX 3.0.1 counterpart.

SoftwareArtifact.downloadLocation and ExternalRef (altDownloadLocation, altWebPage, documentation) give the access links per channel; Relationship availableFrom -> Agent names the distributor; SoftwareService (Service profile, 3.1-dev; serviceHostingCountry) models API access. GAP: the channel type and level of model access (weights-level vs black-box) have no vocabulary -- use ExternalRef.comment or a CdxPropertiesExtension. closeMatch.

Relationship with relationshipType availableFrom links the AIPackage to the Agent(s) it is available from; hasDistributionArtifact links it to the distributed artifacts (weights archive, container image). closeMatch.
Same constructs as the Union-market list (downloadLocation, ExternalRef, availableFrom, hasDistributionArtifact, SoftwareService). GAP for channel type / access level. closeMatch.

Relationship hasDeclaredLicense from the AIPackage to a ListedLicense (for SPDX-listed licences), a CustomLicense (licenseText, seeAlso link) or LicenseExpression; NoneLicense when no model licence exists. Exact match.
ExternalRef with externalRefType license links the licence text when it is not an SPDX LicenseExpression. closeMatch.

The licence category (free and open source / restrictive / proprietary / terms of service) is derivable from the declared licence: ListedLicense.isOsiApproved and isFsfLibre flag open-source licences; a CustomLicense with licenseText covers proprietary terms or terms of service. GAP: no explicit category vocabulary. closeMatch.

Model each additional asset (training data as DatasetPackage; data processing, training, inference and evaluation code as Package with primaryPurpose source) as its own element with downloadLocation and hasDeclaredLicense, linked from the AIPackage by contains, trainedOn / testedOn (datasets) or hasPrerequisite (code). closeMatch.
ExternalRef with externalRefType license links the acceptable-use policy or licence terms that carry the restrictions. closeMatch.
Artifact.intendedUse (3.1-dev) may state the boundaries of appropriate use, but the acceptable-use policy itself is carried by the declared licence or an ExternalRef of type license. relatedMatch.
Artifact.intendedUse (0..1, 3.1-dev): a statement of how or for what purpose the artifact is intended to be used. Exact match for alternative (i). AIPackage.domain lists the application domains.
AIPackage.domain (0..*, string) names the application domains; the sector half of an intended-use statement. relatedMatch.
Alternative (ii), restricted or prohibited uses: AIPackage.limitation (free text) is the closest field. closeMatch.

column2: Type and nature of AI systems in which the general-purpose AI model can be integrated
column8: AIPackage.informationAboutApplication (free text) describes the kinds of AI systems the model can be integrated into; limitation covers systems it should not be integrated into; domain lists application domains. closeMatch; no vocabulary for system types (GAP).
ExternalRef with externalRefType documentation links the instructions for use; a Relationship with relationshipType hasDocumentation to a File is the bundled form. closeMatch.

Hardware profile (3.1-dev): Hardware/Hardware (or PhysicalHardware / VirtualHardware) elements with partNumber and version, linked from the AIPackage by Relationship runsOn (to = Hardware; hasHost is defined for Build elements only) or hasPrerequisite. 'N/A' for API-only models = no such relationship. Exact match.

Software/Package elements (name, version, packageUrl) for required frameworks, runtimes and libraries, linked from the AIPackage by a LifecycleScopedRelationship dependsOn with scope runtime, or by hasPrerequisite (runsOn targets Hardware only). closeMatch: Package is the class of every software package; the dependsOn relationship identifies the infrastructure items.

column2: Design specifications of the training process
column8: AIPackage.informationAboutTraining (0..1, free text) describes the training process: stages, methodologies, techniques, optimisation target. hyperparameter carries the concrete parameters; pretrainedOn / finetunedOn relationships link each stage's dataset. closeMatch: the narrative field covers the specification together with hyperparameter and the training relationships.

GAP (missing field): no rationale field on AIPackage (Core/rationale exists only on DefinedProcess, Requirement and the FunctionalSafety assessment classes). Include the rationale in informationAboutTraining or model the training as a DefinedProcess with rationale. closeMatch.

DatasetPackage.datasetType (1..*, DatasetType: text, image, audio, video, structured, ...) on each training / testing / validation DatasetPackage linked from the model by trainedOn / testedOn / validatedOn. Exact match.

DatasetPackage.dataCollectionProcess (0..1, string) states how the data was gathered; the MDF provenance categories (web crawling, third-party private datasets, user data, public datasets, synthetic, other) are values of that process. closeMatch (the categories mix sources and methods). GAP (vocabulary): no enumeration for the categories, so they are recorded as free text.

column2: How data was obtained and selected
column8: DatasetPackage.dataCollectionProcess (0..1, free text) describes how and from where the data was gathered, selection and annotation methods; synthetic-data generation models are AIPackages linked by generates; rights to third-party data have no field (hasDeclaredLicense on the DatasetPackage is the closest). closeMatch for the narrative (the item also covers annotation and rights acquisition).

GAP (semantic): SoftwareArtifact.byteSize (0..1, nonNegativeInteger; replaces Dataset/datasetSize, DEPRECATED in 3.1) is the size in bytes, not a count of data points with a stated unit (tokens, images, hours). Carry the count and unit in Element.description or a CdxPropertiesExtension; one DatasetPackage each for training, testing and validation splits. closeMatch.

GAP (missing field): no field for the number of data points or their unit. Core/additionalInformation (0..*, DictionaryEntry key/value; on SoftwareArtifact and so on AIPackage and DatasetPackage since the 2026-10 3.1-dev model) is the structured carrier for an intrinsic characteristic that has no dedicated property. Record the count under the key 'itemCount' and what is counted (tokens, images, hours, ...) under 'itemType', on each DatasetPackage (one each for the training, testing and validation splits). Complements the byteSize row, which gives the size in bytes only. additionalInformationSpecification can name the Specification that defines the key. broadMatch (container fallback; key convention only, not standardised). No SPDX 3.0.1 counterpart.

Element.description on each DatasetPackage carries the general scope description (domain, geography); Core/inLanguage (0..*, LanguageTag) on DatasetPackage carries languages; datasetType carries modality coverage; Core/intendedUse (Dataset/intendedUse is DEPRECATED in 3.1) states the dataset's intended use. closeMatch.

DatasetPackage.inLanguage (0..*, LanguageTag) lists the languages present in the dataset, one of the scope aspects (domain, geography, language, modality); the domain aspect itself only has Element.description. closeMatch for the language sub-aspect.
DatasetPackage.datasetType (1..*, DatasetType vocabulary) carries the modality coverage aspect of the scope description. closeMatch (one of several aspects: domain, geography, language, modality).

GAP (missing field): AI/domain is defined on AIPackage only, so a DatasetPackage has no subject-domain field. Core/additionalInformation (0..*, DictionaryEntry key/value; on SoftwareArtifact and so on AIPackage and DatasetPackage since the 2026-10 3.1-dev model) is the structured carrier for an intrinsic characteristic that has no dedicated property. Record the domain aspect of the scope under the key 'subjectDomain' (comma-separated list such as 'medical,legal'); geography has no field and stays in Element.description, language and modality have inLanguage and datasetType. additionalInformationSpecification can name the Specification that defines the key. broadMatch (container fallback; key convention only, not standardised). No SPDX 3.0.1 counterpart.
DatasetPackage.dataPreprocessing (0..*, string) describes cleaning, normalisation (tokenization) and augmentation steps; AIPackage.modelDataPreprocessing mirrors it on the model side. Exact match.

column2: Measures to detect unsuitability of data sources
column8: GAP (missing field): no field for content-safety filtering measures (illegal content, CSAM, NCII, unlawful personal data). Describe them within dataPreprocessing; anonymizationMethodUsed and hasSensitivePersonalInformation cover the personal-data aspect. broadMatch (container fallback).

column2: Measures to detect unsuitability of data sources
column8: DatasetPackage.anonymizationMethodUsed (0..*, string) and hasSensitivePersonalInformation (PresenceType) cover the personal-data part of the unsuitability measures. closeMatch (partial).
DatasetPackage.knownBias (0..*, string) records identified biases; the methods used to detect and address them have no dedicated field and go in the same text or dataPreprocessing. closeMatch.

Model the training run as a Build/Build element (Core/startTime, Core/endTime, buildType, environment, parameter; buildStartTime / buildEndTime are DEPRECATED in 3.1) linked to the AIPackage by a generates Relationship; wall-clock duration = endTime - startTime. GAP: hardware-days (e.g. A100 days) and the duration range have no field; Build.environment / parameter DictionaryEntry can carry them informally. closeMatch.

column2: Amount of computation used for training
column8: GAP (missing field): no FLOP / compute-amount field in SPDX 3.1-dev. State it in informationAboutTraining (free text); hyperparameter does not fit (it holds settings fixed before training, not a measured amount); Core/UnitOfMeasure (quantity + QUDT unit) exists but is not attached to any AI property. broadMatch (container fallback); candidate input to the SPDX AI profile.

column2: Amount of computation used for training
column8: GAP (missing field): no FLOP / compute-amount field. Core/additionalInformation (0..*, DictionaryEntry key/value; on SoftwareArtifact and so on AIPackage since the 2026-10 3.1-dev model) is the structured carrier for an intrinsic characteristic that has no dedicated property. Record it under the key 'trainingCompute' with the FLOP count such as '2.4e25'; the methodology stays in informationAboutTraining. additionalInformationSpecification can name the Specification that defines the key. broadMatch (container fallback; key convention only, not standardised). No SPDX 3.0.1 counterpart.
GAP (missing field): free-text only (informationAboutTraining). broadMatch (container fallback).

column2: Amount of energy used for training
column8: AIPackage.energyConsumption -> EnergyConsumption.trainingEnergyConsumption -> EnergyConsumptionDescription {energyQuantity (decimal), energyUnit}. GAP (vocabulary): EnergyUnitType has kilowattHour, megajoule, other -- report MWh as kilowattHour x 1000 (or unit other with comment). 'N/A' has no marker; omit with comment. Exact match for the quantity.

GAP (missing field): no methodology field on EnergyConsumptionDescription (no comment property either); describe the methodology in informationAboutTraining or Element.comment. broadMatch (container fallback).

column2: Benchmarked amount of computation used for inference
column8: GAP (semantic): SPDX has inferenceEnergyConsumption (energy, kWh/MJ) but no inference compute (FLOP) field. State the benchmarked FLOP in informationAboutApplication (free text); metric does not fit (it holds measures of prediction quality, not of resource use). relatedMatch (energy, not compute).

column2: Benchmarked amount of computation used for inference
column8: GAP (missing field): no inference-compute field; AIPackage.informationAboutApplication (free text) carries the FLOP figure. broadMatch (container).

column2: Benchmarked amount of computation used for inference
column8: GAP (missing field): no inference compute (FLOP) field. Core/additionalInformation (0..*, DictionaryEntry key/value; on SoftwareArtifact and so on AIPackage since the 2026-10 3.1-dev model) is the structured carrier for an intrinsic characteristic that has no dedicated property. Record it under the key 'inferenceCompute' with the benchmarked FLOP count; the benchmark and methodology stay in informationAboutApplication. additionalInformationSpecification can name the Specification that defines the key. broadMatch (container fallback; key convention only, not standardised). No SPDX 3.0.1 counterpart.

GAP (missing field): describe the benchmark task and hardware in informationAboutApplication; the hardware used can be modelled as Hardware elements linked by a Build element (environment) if desired. broadMatch (container fallback).
